name: exo-browser-ui
description: Exo Browser's interface: its Bar, new tab page, Settings and Exo Vault, in Exo Launcher's look.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-exo.mjs && node scripts/icons.mjs && node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p . && vite build
scripts.check: node scripts/icons.mjs --check && node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p . && eslint src/browser src/setup --max-warnings 0 && node scripts/css-design.mjs css-design.config.mjs src/browser && node scripts/css-design.mjs css-design.config.mjs src/setup && node scripts/browser-design.mjs
